space.caveat: Sparse conversion allocation unknown until measured; root43 allocation is an estimate, not proof. Later writable overlays can grow to virtual-size; no guarantee this capacity supports unlimited attempts.

ordered_proposal.reason: Source must remain exact immutable stage50; never use forensic62/63.

ordered_proposal.action: qemu-img convert -f qcow2 -O raw -S 4k SOURCE_STAGE50_ROOT NEW_RAW using disk_overlay.tool_run recorded environment.
ordered_proposal.limit: Do not use -B/rebase or convert in place. No --salvage or guest filesystem repair.

ordered_proposal.action: Rerun source load_stopped_overlay and compare all pre/post identities, hashes and reports. Fresh hash new raw before/after metadata recording. Freeze ONLY NEW_RAW once to0444, then record its final identity with no writableFD. Preserve a separate flatten-provenance JSON linking source chain, compare result, raw hash and virtual geometry.
ordered_proposal.no_invention: Do not manufacture a boot report, successful iOS milestone, normal QMP exit, or ctime attestation for this host conversion.

ordered_proposal.action: Place explicit KEEP-OVERLAY-BACKING.json for the new raw in its new directory before using it; retain original50 and ancestors as historical source even though new raw is logically standalone.
ordered_proposal.source_detail: create_overlay(raw) records dependency warning but does not call protect_dependencies; operator must intentionally retain new backing.

ordered_proposal.action: Use existing verified helper-attempt55/profile.json (actual original recovery ramdisk with owned bounded staging helper), no rebuild needed if hashes still match. Run existing boot.py with --root-image NEW_RAW --root-sha256 HASH --root-overlay --auxiliary-state STAGE50 --ramdisk-boot, plus ordinary isolated output/duration/headless flags.
ordered_proposal.scope: Existing-volumes mode replaces owned files only; no role/keybag/SEP/firmware recreation or launchd-cache replacement. Original ramdisk mount/unmount/file APIs; no signature forgery or grant change.

ordered_proposal.action: Require actual four zero-mismatch readbacks, PREP_COMPLETE, clean guest unmount and normal QMPquit/exit; preserve stopped seven hashes and backing unchanged. Then freeze only new stagedroot and use its owned report for future child boot with copied paired staged auxiliaries.
ordered_proposal.depth: Stage is one qcow2 over newraw; subsequent boot is two qcow2 layers, within max4. Existing raw43 ancestry retained but no longer backing this new chain.

gate_limits: boot.py raw-root path checks GPT4096 plus hash and read-only backing; it does not validate old logical ancestry automatically. Flatten sidecar is essential explicit provenance, not a fake loader exemption.
--auxiliary-state runtime gate accepts any integer stopped exit; this proposed workflow independently requires exact successfully validated stage50 and all six manifest hashes, never failed62/63.
Recovery creates ordinary APFS/checkpoint/boot/NVRAM changes. Same logical starting50 plus HID55 staging is useful diagnostic capability addition, not a clean HID-only causal experiment.
SAMPLE_READY and successful guest sampling remain future actual milestones; no claim the proposal already captures stacks.
